entry_points.summary: Four-phase command: slug discovery, finalized validation, memoize, Sonnet draft, gap-fill, write finals
Per-field schema validator; returns error string or None before any write
Dedup by key fields (task or id); replaces existing or appends

invariants: Never fabricates gap content — ships with honest gaps flagged
Memoizes: skips regeneration if tier2-context.json hash matches .memo
Requires tier2-context.json finalized: true before /z-doc-rationale runs
Atomic writes only: tmp + os.replace, never partial state
gotchas: Only z-review-all currently writes to tier2-context.json; z-plan and z-implement-all do NOT call append-tier2-context.py despite script supporting --phase plan|implement
Significance gate is three-signal OR: consultant_findings, breaking_changes, deviations; all empty = Tier 2 skipped
Tried-and-failed caveat banner required: auto-generated from implementer self-reports, reviewer validation partial
ADR numbering: reads docs/adr/ for max N, allocates N+1; starts at ADR-001 if dir absent
Upsert key fields: task for tried_and_failed/deviations/breaking_changes; id for decisions; no key = always append
--mark-amended writes to amend_events[] (ad-hoc field, not in SCHEMA_SKELETON)
